ValidationRule.description: [IRM feedback row OppVR31] Requires (Deal) Close Date on moving into Solutioning, Negotiation, Booking Verification, Booked, Setup or Closed - record should never be saved without a Close Date. Simplified per IRM feedback.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Framework_Parent_Opportunity', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Standard_Opportunity' ),
OR( ISPICKVAL(Type, 'New Deal'), ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Cross-Sell/Upsell'), ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Renewal') ),
OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Qualification'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Solutioning'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Negotiation'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Booking Verification'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Booked'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Setup'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Closed') ),
ISBLANK(CloseDate) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Deal Close Date is required to advance to the next stage. Please enter a date.
